dispatches_approval_stamps.name: dispatches_approval_stamps
dispatches_approval_stamps.value:
(status in ('approved', 'cancelled')) = (approved_at is not null)
          and (status in ('approved', 'cancelled')) = (approved_by_user_id is not null)

dispatches_payment_method.name: dispatches_payment_method
dispatches_payment_method.value: payment_method is not null or status <> 'approved'

dispatches_payment_note.name: dispatches_payment_note
dispatches_payment_note.value: payment_note is null or payment_method is not null

dispatches_smac_number_after_approval.name: dispatches_smac_number_after_approval
dispatches_smac_number_after_approval.value: smac_dispatch_number is null or status in ('approved', 'cancelled')

dispatches_difference_flag.name: dispatches_difference_flag
dispatches_difference_flag.value:
(differed_at_submission is null) = (lines_changed_after_submission is null)
          and (differed_at_submission is not null)
              = (submitted_at is not null and quotation_version_id is not null)

notifications_live_key.name: notifications_live_key
notifications_live_key.where: "notifications"."resolved_at" is null and "notifications"."record_id" is not null

projects_loss_detail.name: projects_loss_detail
projects_loss_detail.value: loss_reason is null or lost_reason_id is not null

projects_loss_state.name: projects_loss_state
projects_loss_state.value: lost_reason_id is null or end_state is not distinct from 'lost'

rep_reports_shape.name: rep_reports_shape
rep_reports_shape.value:
(
        entry_type = 'interaction'
        and company_id is not null
        and channel is not null
        and outcome is not null
        and category is null
        and city_id is null
      ) or (
        entry_type = 'field_note'
        and company_id is null
        and contact_id is null
        and project_id is null
        and channel is null
        and outcome is null
        and category is not null
      )
